gws --help.stdout:
gws — Google Workspace CLI

USAGE:
    gws <service> <resource> [sub-resource] <method> [flags]
    gws schema <service.resource.method> [--resolve-refs]

EXAMPLES:
    gws drive files list --params '{"pageSize": 10}'
    gws drive files get --params '{"fileId": "abc123"}'
    gws sheets spreadsheets get --params '{"spreadsheetId": "..."}'
    gws gmail users messages list --params '{"userId": "me"}'
    gws schema drive.files.list

FLAGS:
    --params <JSON>       URL/Query parameters as JSON
    --json <JSON>         Request body as JSON (POST/PATCH/PUT)
    --upload <PATH>       Local file to upload as media content (multipart)
    --output <PATH>       Output file path for binary responses
    --format <FMT>        Output format: json (default), table, yaml, csv
    --api-version <VER>   Override the API version (e.g., v2, v3)
    --page-all            Auto-paginate, one JSON line per page (NDJSON)
    --page-limit <N>      Max pages to fetch with --page-all (default: 10)
    --page-delay <MS>     Delay between pages in ms (default: 100)

SERVICES:
    drive                Manage files, folders, and shared drives
    sheets               Read and write spreadsheets
    gmail                Send, read, and manage email
    calendar             Manage calendars and events
    admin                Manage users, groups, and devices (also: directory)
    admin-reports        Audit logs and usage reports (also: reports)
    docs                 Read and write Google Docs
    slides               Read and write presentations
    tasks                Manage task lists and tasks
    people               Manage contacts and profiles
    chat                 Manage Chat spaces and messages
    vault                Manage eDiscovery holds and exports
    groupssettings       Manage Google Groups settings
    reseller             Manage Workspace subscriptions
    licensing            Manage product licenses
    apps-script          Manage and execute Apps Script projects (also: script)
    classroom            Manage classes, rosters, and coursework
    cloudidentity        Manage identity groups and memberships
    alertcenter          Manage Workspace security alerts
    forms                Read and write Google Forms
    keep                 Manage Google Keep notes
    meet                 Manage Google Meet conferences
    events               Subscribe to Google Workspace events
    modelarmor           Filter user-generated content for safety
    workflow             Cross-service productivity workflows (also: wf)

ENVIRONMENT:
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_TOKEN               Pre-obtained OAuth2 access token (highest priority)
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CREDENTIALS_FILE    Path to OAuth credentials JSON file
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CLIENT_ID           OAuth client ID (for gws auth login)
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CLIENT_SECRET       OAuth client secret (for gws auth login)
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_ACCOUNT             Default account email for multi-account
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_IMPERSONATED_USER   Email for Domain-Wide Delegation (service accounts)
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CONFIG_DIR          Override config directory (default: ~/.config/gws)
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_SANITIZE_TEMPLATE   Default Model Armor template
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_SANITIZE_MODE       Sanitization mode: warn (default) or block
    GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_PROJECT_ID              GCP project ID fallback for helper commands

COMMUNITY:
    Star the repo: https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli
    Report bugs / request features: https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/issues
    Please search existing issues first; if one already exists, comment there.

DISCLAIMER:
    This is not an officially supported Google product.

  getAddOnContext   Gets metadata for Classroom add-ons in the context of a specific post.

Operations on the 'courseWork' resource

Usage: gws courses courseWork [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create              Creates course work. The resulting course work (and corresponding student submissions) are associated with the Developer Console project of the OAuth client ID used to make the request.
  delete              Deletes a course work. This request must be made by the Developer Console project of the OAuth client ID used to create the corresponding course work item.
  get                 Returns course work. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to access the requested course or course work, or for access errors.
  getAddOnContext     Gets metadata for Classroom add-ons in the context of a specific post.
  list                Returns a list of course work that the requester is permitted to view. Course students may only view `PUBLISHED` course work. Course teachers and domain administrators may view all course work.
  modifyAssignees     Modifies assignee mode and options of a coursework. Only a teacher of the course that contains the coursework may call this method.
  patch               Updates one or more fields of a course work. See google.classroom.v1.CourseWork for details of which fields may be updated and who may change them.
  updateRubric        Updates a rubric. See google.classroom.v1.Rubric for details of which fields can be updated. Rubric update capabilities are limited once grading has started.
  addOnAttachments    Operations on the 'addOnAttachments' resource
  rubrics             Operations on the 'rubrics' resource
  studentSubmissions  Operations on the 'studentSubmissions' resource
  help                Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

[Helper] Subscribe to Workspace events and stream them as NDJSON

      --sanitize <TEMPLATE>   Sanitize API responses through a Model Armor template. Requires cloud-platform scope. Format: projects/PROJECT/locations/LOCATION/templates/TEMPLATE. Also reads GWS_SANITIZE_TEMPLATE env var.

      --event-types <TYPES>   Comma-separated CloudEvents types to subscribe to
      --format <FORMAT>       Output format: json (default), table, yaml, csv
      --project <PROJECT>     GCP project ID for Pub/Sub resources
      --subscription <NAME>   Existing Pub/Sub subscription name (skip setup)
      --max-messages <N>      Max messages per pull batch (default: 10) [default: 10]
      --poll-interval <SECS>  Seconds between pulls (default: 5) [default: 5]
      --once                  Pull once and exit
      --cleanup               Delete created Pub/Sub resources on exit
      --no-ack                Don't auto-acknowledge messages
      --output-dir <DIR>      Write each event to a separate JSON file in this directory
  -h, --help                  Print help

EXAMPLES:

  gws events +subscribe --subscription projects/p/subscriptions/my-sub --once

  Press Ctrl-C to stop gracefully.

      --sanitize <TEMPLATE>   Sanitize API responses through a Model Armor template. Requires cloud-platform scope. Format: projects/PROJECT/locations/LOCATION/templates/TEMPLATE. Also reads GWS_SANITIZE_TEMPLATE env var.

      --poll-interval <SECS>  Seconds between pulls [default: 5]
      --msg-format <FORMAT>   Gmail message format: full, metadata, minimal, raw [default: full] [possible values: full, metadata, minimal, raw]

  gws gmail +watch --project my-project --cleanup --output-dir ./emails

  Without --cleanup, Pub/Sub resources persist for reconnection.
  Press Ctrl-C to stop gracefully.
